title: The reign of judges begins
scene: The people of Zarahemla gather in separate groups across a vast plaza to cast their voices for judges, while the aged King Mosiah watches from a high terrace.

title: Nehor is tried for killing Gideon
scene: Nehor, a large, powerful man in costly clothing, stands bound before Alma's judgment seat after killing the aged Gideon.

title: The sons of Mosiah depart
scene: On a misty mountain ridge at the edge of Lamanite lands, Ammon lays his hands on a brother's head to bless him before the four brothers take separate trails.

title: Ammon defends the flocks
scene: At the waters of Sebus, Ammon whirls his sling and releases a stone at raiders on the far bank, while the king's servants behind him gather the scattered flocks.

title: Persecution, work, and care for the poor
scene: In a narrow, muddy lane, a church member gently places a folded bundle of cotton cloth and maize cakes into the hands of a blind old beggar, while well-dressed men jeer from a doorway behind.

title: Lamoni believes Ammon
scene: King Lamoni cries out for mercy and collapses as if dead, and Ammon catches him before he strikes the floor.

title: Abish raises the queen
scene: The servant woman Abish takes the fallen queen by the hand and lifts her to her feet, while a quarreling crowd crams the doorway and the king, Ammon and servants lie still on the floor.

title: The prisoners of Middoni are freed
scene: Ammon kneels at the opening of a dark prison pit in Middoni and reaches down to his starved brother Aaron, who stretches up toward him, his wrists scarred by cords.

title: A king offers to give away his sins
scene: Lamoni's father, the great Lamanite king, lies face down on the patterned floor of his palace, arms spread, offering to give away all his sins to know God, as Aaron stands over him.

title: The Anti-Nephi-Lehies take a new name
scene: On the terraces of a highland Lamanite village, converted families gather around a council circle where their leaders agree to take a new name, the Anti-Nephi-Lehies.

title: Weapons buried for peace
scene: The people of Anti-Nephi-Lehi drop their swords, clubs, bows and spears into a deep trench, burying them as a covenant never to shed blood again.

title: The unresisting people are attacked
scene: A line of unarmed Anti-Nephi-Lehies lies prostrate on the earth praising God as Lamanite warriors charge at them, and the front warriors halt and throw down their weapons.

title: Amlici’s bid for a crown
scene: Amlici's followers raise him onto a timber platform at night and proclaim him their king, after the voice of the people has rejected him.

title: Battle on the hill Amnihu
scene: On the slopes of the hill Amnihu, east of the river Sidon, Alma's Nephite army breaks the Amlicite ranks, which begin to flee down toward the river.

title: The battle at the Sidon crossing
scene: In the middle of the Sidon crossing, Alma raises his eyes in a desperate prayer as Amlici charges at him through waist-deep water, while Lamanite and Amlicite forces surge across the river behind.

title: A second invasion is repelled
scene: In the foreground, a field of grain lies trampled and broken, with a lost sandal and a cracked water jar; far behind, Nephite troops drive the second invading army back over a ridge.

title: Mourning gives way to renewal
scene: In the foreground, a mourning family kneels at fresh graves on the riverbank; beyond them, a long line of people waits in the misty river Sidon as Alma baptizes a man.

title: Alma relinquishes the judgment seat
scene: Alma walks out of the judgment hall into the bright street to preach, leaving the stone judgment seat to Nephihah, who stands beside it with one hand resting on it.

title: A call to change in Zarahemla
scene: In a Zarahemla street, Alma's call to repentance lands differently on two listeners: a proud man in costly clothing turns away, and a poor woman beside him weeps with her hand over her mouth.

title: Alma teaches in Gideon
scene: In the valley of Gideon, Alma sits on the ground among a small group of faithful families in a shaded cacao orchard, gently teaching them.

title: The ministry in Melek
scene: Families from the wilderness borders walk in a long line across open grassland toward a river, where Alma, a small figure in the distance, baptizes the first of them.

title: An angel sends Alma back
scene: On a muddy road in the rain, Alma, weighed down with sorrow after being cast out of Ammonihah, kneels with his head bowed, as a man in plain white clothing stands before him delivering God's command to return.

title: Amulek refuses Zeezrom’s bribe
scene: In the crowded court of Ammonihah, Zeezrom holds out six pieces of silver on his open palm to Amulek, who pushes the hand away with his own raised palm.

title: The plan of redemption is taught
scene: As Alma speaks, the lawyer Zeezrom begins to tremble, sweating and clutching the edge of a table, the realization of his own guilt breaking through his pride.

title: The martyrs of Ammonihah
scene: Alma and Amulek, bound with cords, are forced to watch the fire off-frame. Amulek strains forward to stop it, and Alma, bound beside him, lays his hand on Amulek's arm to hold him back.

title: The prison falls
scene: The walls of Ammonihah's prison crack and collapse in a towering cloud of dust, and Alma and Amulek walk calmly out through the rubble as terrified townspeople flee toward the viewer.

title: Zeezrom is healed in Sidom
scene: In a small house in Sidom, Zeezrom, burning with fever, grips Alma's hand and leaps up from his sleeping mat, suddenly whole, as his household gasps.

title: Amulek finds a home with Alma
scene: At dusk, Alma leads the weary Amulek, rejected by his father and kin, through the doorway of his own house in Zarahemla, where his household waits with a lamp.

title: Ammonihah is destroyed
scene: The city of Ammonihah lies empty and destroyed in a single day, its streets silent, its roofs burned away.

title: Zoram rescues the captives
scene: At a jungle river ford in the south wilderness, rescued Nephite women and children run through the shallows into the arms of soldiers, as Zoram stands watch on a rock.

title: Persecution turns against the Amulonites
scene: Painted Lamanite warriors cross a stream into an Anti-Nephi-Lehi village and lay their weapons on a pile before a village elder, choosing to join the people they had come to fight.

title: The Church spreads through the land
scene: Alma and Amulek teach inside a synagogue built after the manner of the Jews, where farmers, merchants and elders sit together on benches around a raised reading platform, faces bright with joy.

title: Alma and the missionaries reunite
scene: On a wilderness road near Manti, Ammon is so overcome with joy at meeting Alma that his strength leaves him and he sinks to his knees, as Alma catches him and the brothers crowd around, laughing and weeping.

title: Refuge in the land of Jershon
scene: The people of Ammon, carrying their bundles and driving their flocks, walk into the land of Jershon by the sea, while a line of Nephite soldiers stands between them and the inland wilderness, facing outward to guard them.

title: A tremendous battle and mourning
scene: After a tremendous battle, the women and old men of Jershon mourn in the rain: a widow cries out to the sky with her torn mantle in her fists, and an old father holds his son's broken bow against his chest.

title: Korihor confronts Alma
scene: Struck dumb, Korihor kneels on the stone floor and writes with a trembling hand on a tablet that he cannot speak, while the chief judge and Alma look down at him.

title: Alma encounters the Rameumptom
scene: A richly dressed Zoramite stands alone on top of the Rameumptom, a tall, narrow prayer stand, arms stretched toward the sky as he recites the same proud prayer, while Alma and his companions watch from below in grief.

title: The word compared to a seed
scene: On the rocky hill Onidah, the poor who were cast out of the synagogues for their coarse clothing crowd close around Alma, who kneels among them as a ragged man holds out his rough, work-scarred hands and asks what they should do.

title: Jershon welcomes the expelled converts
scene: On a rainy night in Jershon, people of Ammon wrap their own mantles around exhausted, shivering Zoramite converts who have been cast out of their city, under a long thatched shelter lit by fires.

title: The people of Ammon move to Melek
scene: At a river ford, the people of Ammon leave Jershon heading west with their bundles and flocks, while a Nephite army marches the other way to take up position in the land they are vacating.

title: Alma entrusts the sacred records to Helaman
scene: By the light of one oil lamp, Alma's old hands place a stack of engraved metal plates into his son Helaman's hands; beside them on the table lie a plain round brass director and two stones set in a frame.

title: Alma counsels faithful Shiblon
scene: At dawn, Alma and his son Shiblon walk slowly together along a city wall above Zarahemla, and Alma rests his hand on his son's shoulder as he speaks.

title: Alma calls Corianton back to his ministry
scene: Late at night, Corianton sits on a stone bench with his head in his hands, and Alma stands at the far side of the room, about to cross toward him.

title: The battle at the river Sidon
scene: On the banks of the river Sidon, Moroni raises his hand to stop his soldiers as the surrounded Lamanite army, pressed against the water, wavers in terror.

title: Zerahemnah’s scalp
scene: A Nephite soldier lifts Zerahemnah's scalp, a dark tuft of hair, on the point of his sword and shouts a warning to the Lamanite army, while Zerahemnah stumbles back clutching his head and Lamanite warriors begin to drop their weapons.

title: Alma’s last charge and departure
scene: Alma, now very old, walks away alone along a road from Zarahemla into the wilderness toward Melek, never to be seen again, while his son Helaman watches from the city wall.

title: Moroni raises the title of liberty
scene: In a wind-whipped plaza, Moroni lifts a pole bearing a torn piece of his own red coat while the people run to him girding on their armor, tearing their garments and casting them at his feet as a covenant.

title: Lehonti is betrayed at Antipas
scene: At night on the slope of Mount Antipas, Amalickiah clasps Lehonti's forearm in a show of friendship, while behind him a servant waits in shadow holding a small clay vessel.

title: Amalickiah takes the Lamanite throne
scene: In the throne room of the city of Nephi, Amalickiah kneels in false sympathy before the grieving Lamanite queen, while his false witnesses point toward the doorway, blaming the king's fled servants.

title: The fortified cities hold
scene: From the top of the earth bank at the city of Noah, Lehi's defenders hurl stones and shoot arrows down into the ditch, where Lamanite soldiers try to dig at the bank with picks and climb it.

title: Amalickiah swears an oath against Moroni
scene: In his throne room in the city of Nephi, Amalickiah, enraged by news of defeat, hurls a drinking cup to the floor and swears an oath against Moroni, while a messenger lies flat on the floor before him.

title: Fortifications and new coastal cities
scene: Moroni's people build a long line of earthworks topped with timber pickets and watchtowers stretching toward the east sea, as families arrive at the new city of Moroni with their goods.

title: Morianton’s flight is stopped
scene: On a rainy night, a young maidservant who has fled Morianton bursts into Moroni's camp, soaked and breathless, and soldiers part as Moroni rises to hear her warning.

title: Pahoran succeeds Nephihah
scene: In the hall of judgment, the new chief judge Pahoran kneels as two elders lay the white judge's mantle over his shoulders, with Nephihah's empty seat before him.

title: The king-men challenge the government
scene: In a Zarahemla plaza, the king-men in rich dress confront the freemen in plain dress, and Pahoran stands alone in the middle where the voice of the people will decide.

title: Amalickiah captures the eastern cities
scene: On the seashore at the borders of Bountiful, Teancum's warriors hold a line on the dunes against Amalickiah's advancing army as the sun sets, fighting until dark.

title: Teancum kills Amalickiah
scene: Inside a royal tent at night, Amalickiah sleeps in the foreground, and in the open tent flap behind him stands Teancum's silhouette, javelin raised, against the moonlit beach.

title: Ammoron opens a western front
scene: At dawn on the beach, Lamanite captains gather at the open royal tent and recoil in fear at finding Amalickiah dead, while far down the shore Teancum's army stands ready for battle.

title: The mothers’ teaching
scene: On the night before her son leaves for war, a mother of the people of Ammon kneels with him by the hearth, holding his face in her hands as she teaches him not to doubt, while his father, who has covenanted never to fight again, stands in the doorway.

title: Two thousand sons join Helaman
scene: At the half-built defenses of Judea, Antipus's weary, bandaged soldiers look up from their digging as Helaman leads a column of two thousand young men out of the morning fog toward them.

title: The young soldiers turn back to battle
scene: On a jungle trail, Helaman's two thousand young soldiers stop their flight and turn around as one to go back to help the army of Antipus.

title: Mulek is retaken by a feigned retreat
scene: Along the seashore, Teancum's small force retreats north, drawing a huge Lamanite army out of the fortified city of Mulek in pursuit, while behind them Moroni's men slip into the emptied city.

title: Bountiful becomes a prison stronghold
scene: Lamanite prisoners haul heavy timbers out of the deep ditch around Bountiful and raise them into a towering wall, under watch from guards on the bank above.

title: Antiparah is abandoned
scene: Helaman's young soldiers walk warily into the deserted city of Antiparah, where doors hang open, pots are left on cold hearths and a single cooking fire still smokes.

title: The prisoner exchange breaks down
scene: In his army tent, Moroni crushes Ammoron's insulting letter in his fist, his jaw tight with anger, while the Lamanite messenger waits stiffly at the tent door.

title: The prisoners of Gid are freed
scene: On a moonless night, bundles of swords and spears are lowered on cords over the wall of Gid into the reaching hands of Nephite prisoners below, while drunken Lamanite guards sleep slumped beside empty wine jars.

title: Cumeni falls and survives a counterattack
scene: As the Lamanites counterattack at Cumeni, Helaman's young soldiers hold their line without flinching, shields locked and atlatls drawn back, while older Nephite troops waver behind them.

title: None were slain
scene: By torchlight after the battle of Cumeni, Helaman walks slowly along rows of wounded young soldiers lying on mats, counting them one by one and touching each head, astonished that not one has died.

title: Prayer and stratagem recover Manti
scene: On a hillside before dawn, Helaman's exhausted, hungry army kneels in prayer, and across the valley the watchfires of Manti burn on the opposite hill.

title: Nephihah falls as the armies await help
scene: At dusk on the road, Moroni listens to a soot-blackened captain report the fall of Nephihah, while a stream of refugees passes behind them and the city burns on the horizon.

title: Pahoran reveals the rebellion
scene: Sitting on a rock outside his camp at morning, Moroni reads Pahoran's reply, and his hard, angry face softens into relief and joy as he learns that Pahoran was loyal all along.

title: Pahoran is restored in Zarahemla
scene: Moroni and Pahoran march side by side toward Zarahemla at the head of a swelling army of volunteers who have rallied to the standard of liberty, the torn red banner snapping above them.

title: Nephihah is recovered by night
scene: By moonlight, Moroni's soldiers climb strong cords and ladders up the outside of Nephihah's west wall, the first reaching the top, while the Lamanite army sleeps at the far east gate.

title: Teancum’s final mission and the war’s end
scene: Inside the enemy-held city of Moroni at night, Teancum crouches in the shadow of a wall, javelin drawn back, looking toward the lit doorway of King Ammoron's tent.

title: Moroni and Lehi mourn Teancum
scene: At gray dawn on the seashore, Moroni and Lehi stand over Teancum's body, which lies covered by a mantle on a litter with his javelin laid across it, as soldiers stand with bowed heads.

title: Peace, renewal, and a new commander
scene: In the courtyard of his own house, an older Moroni lays his copper breastplate on a bench, while through the open gate his son Moronihah leads the soldiers away down the road.

title: Shiblon receives the records; Moroni dies
scene: Shiblon, holding the wrapped sacred records against his chest, watches from an upper window as a mourning procession carries a shrouded litter through the street below for Moroni.

title: Hagoth’s ships and the northward migrations
scene: On the west sea near the narrow neck of land, Hagoth's exceedingly large ship slides off log rollers into the surf as families wade out to it carrying baskets of provisions.

title: Helaman receives the records; Moronihah repels an attack
scene: On a high temple terrace at dawn, the aged Shiblon places the cloth-wrapped sacred records into the hands of the young Helaman, while far out on the plain Moronihah's army drives back an invading force in a line of dust.

title: A contested succession and Kishkumen’s murder
scene: In disguise, Kishkumen slips away through a dark colonnade after murdering the chief judge Pahoran, his face hidden, as distant shouts and pursuers' torches fill the bright hall behind him.

title: Coriantumr takes Zarahemla
scene: At dawn, Coriantumr, a large and mighty man, leads his Lamanite army through the broken entrance of Zarahemla so swiftly that the city has no time to gather, as townspeople flee into the streets ahead of him.

title: Zarahemla is retaken
scene: On the open plain, the trapped Lamanite army throws its weapons to the ground as the armies of Lehi and Moronihah close in from both sides.
